Identified as this saint because: An early-14th-century fresco at the Protaton on Athos described as Ephrem the Syrian and filed under that category, the 4th-century venerable of the folder, not Ephrem of Nea Makri. Commons describes it: 14th-century fresco of Ephrem the Syrian (detail),  Church of the Assumption in Protation Monastery, Athos.
